notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Section 3750 was editorially reclassified as section 10151 of Title 34, Crime Control and Law Enforcement.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: Prior sections 3750a to 3750d were repealed by Pub. L. 109–162, title XI, § 1111(b)(2), (d), Jan. 5, 2006, 119 Stat. 3101, 3102, applicable with respect to the first fiscal year beginning after Jan. 5, 2006, and each fiscal year thereafter. Section 3750a, Pub. L. 102–519, title I, § 130, Oct. 25, 1992, 106 Stat. 3386, related to the purpose of former sections 3750a to 3750d, to supplement the provisions of the Edward Byrne Memorial State and Local Law Enforcement Assistance Program to help States to curb motor vehicle thefts and related violence, and authorization of grants to Anti Car Theft Committees. Section 3750b, Pub. L. 102–519, title I, § 131, Oct. 25, 1992, 106 Stat. 3386, related to application for grants. Section 3750c, Pub. L. 102–519, title I, § 132, Oct. 25, 1992, 106 Stat. 3387, related to award of grants. Section 3750d, Pub. L. 102–519, title I, § 133, Oct. 25, 1992, 106 Stat. 3387, related to authorization of appropriations. Other prior sections 3750 to 3750d of this title, which comprised a prior part E of title I of Pub. L. 90–351, were omitted in the general amendment of title I of Pub. L. 90–351 by Pub.
